SECTION 1
*   A 24-year-old writer agrees with a politician that it's unfair to blame young people for not being able to afford a home.
*   He is tired of older people criticizing him for spending money on small enjoyments like holidays, instead of saving for a house he believes he'll never be able to afford anyway.
*   The writer feels that high house prices and banks being unwilling to lend money mean his generation is stuck renting forever from landlords who then call them irresponsible.
*   The text highlights that people under 25 are paid less than older adults for doing the exact same job, as they are not entitled to the full national living wage.
*   This lower pay means a young person might earn a very small annual salary even when working full-time, and they are also more likely to have unstable jobs with no guaranteed hours.
